summary.notes: First run — most failures are fixable code bugs in agent-generated notebooks

results.error: validate_parameter_constraints error — likely passing invalid parameter to LinearDiscriminantAnalysis (e.g., shrinkage with svd solver, or misspelled parameter name)
Error in covariance heatmap visualization cell — likely array shape mismatch in make_subplots or indexing issue with class-conditional covariance matrices
ZeroDivisionError in the tree_to_plotly() treemap visualization — division by zero when a leaf node has zero samples. Needs guard: 'total = n0 + n1; if total == 0: continue'
DataFrame constructor error — likely mismatched array lengths in variance analysis or OOB error curve cell. Check that all parallel arrays have same length.

Error in feature importance extraction — BaggingClassifier stores base estimators differently. Need to access estimator importances via ensemble.estimators_[i].feature_importances_ and handle feature name alignment.
TypeError in worked example cell — likely passing wrong argument type to AdaBoostClassifier (base_estimator deprecated in newer sklearn, use estimator= instead) or Pipeline issue.
Error in worked example pseudo-residual computation — likely indexing issue accessing transformed data or trying to use raw df values when transformed array is needed.
Error in staged predictions cell — XGBClassifier staged prediction API differs from sklearn. Need to use model.predict() at each iteration or alternative approach.
TIMEOUT (300s) — likely GridSearchCV with too large a parameter grid is taking too long. Reduce grid size or use RandomizedSearchCV.
TIMEOUT (300s) — CatBoost manual grid search with too many combinations. Reduce grid size significantly (target <50 combinations).
IndexError: invalid index to scalar variable — likely in support vector analysis or kernel visualization. Check array indexing when extracting support vectors or decision function values.

TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for +: 'int' and 'str' — likely in hidden_layer_sizes handling. GridSearchCV parameter 'clf__hidden_layer_sizes' must be tuples, not strings. Also training might be slow (increase max_iter timeout or reduce grid).
